About

I’m a Senior Art Director working between Cairo and Riyadh. I lead creative direction for Mobily, from nationwide airport campaigns to Hajj, Umrah, Saudi National Day and Founding Day, across digital, social and OOH.

Before telecom I worked on food, government, healthcare and FMCG brands, including Domino’s, Maestro Pizza, the Ministry of Health, the Ministry of Investment, Danone and Amstel Radler.

I also build AI into campaign development and high-end visual production.
